args.summary: checkout-api deployments v2.3.1 (and the v2.3.1-rc staging candidate) were failing health checks in production. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification shows all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis:** Deployment history showed checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (its v2.3.1-rc staging predecessor was also unhealthy), while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.

**Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). This didn't require change-manager approval since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.

**Verification:** Post-rollback, the service reports healthy in all three regions with an error rate of ~0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") summarizing the failures and the mitigation. The on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause of v2.3.1's failures is still under investigation.
